description: Reviewed names for the five named components, the v1 ids each canonical id keeps as an alias (ADR 0011), and optional annotations of at most 280 characters (ADR 0012). Every other entry is labelled by its rays (ADR 0014). Keys are canonical catalog ids.

mi-p1-0-1.label: Main cardioid
mi-p1-0-1.annotation: Parameters with an attracting fixed point. Where the fixed point's multiplier on the boundary is e^(2πi·p/q), with p/q in lowest terms and q ≥ 2, a bulb of period q is attached.

mi-p2-1-2.label: Period-2 bulb
mi-p2-1-2.annotation: Parameters with an attracting 2-cycle: the disk of radius 1/4 about −1. It meets the main cardioid at c = −3/4, where the rays 1/3 and 2/3 land.

mi-p3-1-2.label: Douady rabbit
mi-p3-1-2.annotation: The 1/3 bulb of the main cardioid. At its centre the Julia set is the Douady rabbit: three Fatou components meet at the α fixed point and at each of its preimages. Rays 1/7 and 2/7 land at its root.

mi-p3-3-4.label: Airplane
mi-p3-3-4.annotation: The period-3 component on the real axis, the main cardioid of a small copy of the Mandelbrot set; along the real line it is the logistic map's period-3 window. Rays 3/7 and 4/7 land at its cusp, c = −7/4.

mi-p3-5-6.label: Co-rabbit
mi-p3-5-6.annotation: The 2/3 bulb, the complex conjugate of the rabbit's 1/3 bulb; its Julia sets are mirror images of the rabbit's. Rays 5/7 and 6/7 land at its root.
